event.title: South African President Promises Justice Amid Discovery of Women's Bodies Near Johannesburg
event.canonical_title: South African President Promises Justice Amid Discovery of Women's Bodies Near Johannesburg
event.summary: The South African president has pledged justice following the discovery of multiple women's bodies near Johannesburg. The latest victim was found in the same area where several others have been discovered over the past two months, raising concerns about a potential serial killer. Police are investigating the situation but have not yet confirmed any links between the deaths.

timeline.summary: The recent discovery of the bodies of nine women near Johannesburg over the past two months has alarmed South Africa, drawing attention to the ongoing issue of femicide and high violent crime rates in the country. Authorities are investigating the possibility of a serial killer or a group of killers behind these incidents.
